registry_note: Versioned category-policy registry (ACT-004). The single authority for per-category listing limits used by the listing generator, compliance validator, and dashboard. Limits are the toolkit owner's documented working values for Amazon US listing optimization and customer experience; they are NOT redistributions of an official Amazon rule table. Verify your exact category in Seller Central before publishing. Not legal advice.
